hints.title: Count Votes per Position
hints.text: For each team letter, count how many 1st, 2nd, ..., m-th place votes they received.

hints.title: Position Vote Vectors
hints.text: Represent each team as a vector of counts for each position. Compare vectors lexicographically in reverse (higher votes first).

hints.title: Alphabetical Tie Breaker
hints.text: If two teams have identical vote counts for all positions, tie-break by team letter in alphabetical order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple pairwise round-robin fails to reflect rank-order voting rules.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting per-position votes and sorting 26 teams by vector comparison runs in negligible time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the position-by-position comparison vector and alphabetical tie break.
